chapterInfo.content:
3
Esu a ɛfata Kristofoɔ akannifoɔ
1 # Aso 20.28 Ɛyɛ nokwasɛm sɛ, sɛ obi pɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ adwuma a, na wapɛ adwuma pa. 2#Tito 1.6-7 Nso deɛ ɛsɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ ne sɛ wɔnnya ne ho asɛm bi nka, ɔyɛ ɔyerɛ baako kunu, n’ani so da hɔ, n’adwene mu te, ɔyɛ ne ho wesee, ɔpɛ ahɔhoyɛ, ɔnim nkyerɛkyerɛ, 3ɔnyɛ ɔsadweam, ɔnyɛ pupopupo, na mmom ɔdwo, ɔnyɛ ntɔkwapɛ, ɔnyɛ sikanibereɛ; 4#1 Sa 2.12 ɔdi ɔno ara ne fie so yie ma ne mma hyɛ n’ase animuduro nyinaa mu. 5Na sɛ obi nhunu ne fie so hwɛ a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na ɔbɛhwɛ Nyankopɔn asafo soɔ? 6Ɔnyɛ abɛɛfo, na wanhoran anhwe ɔbonsam atemmuo mu. 7#1 Ko 5.12-13; 1 Ti 5.10 Nanso ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔtete ho no bɔ no din pa, na wanhwe ahohora ne ɔbonsam afidie mu.
Esu a ɛfata asomfoɔ ne wɔn yerenom
8 # Flp 1.1; Aso 6.3 Asafo mu asomfoɔ nso, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn anim yɛ duro, wɔnyɛ ano nta, wɔnyɛ asadweam, wɔnyɛ adufudepɛfoɔ; 9wɔde gyidie ahuntasɛm no sie ahonim a emu teɛ mu. 10Ma wɔnsɔ yeinom nhwɛ kane, na sɛ asɛm bi nni wɔn ho ansa a, wɔama wɔasom. 11#Tito 2.3 Mmaa no nso anim nyɛ duru saa ara, wɔnnyɛ nsekubɔfoɔ, wɔn ani so nna hɔ, wɔnni ade nyinaa mu nokorɛ. 12#1 Ti 3.2 Asafo mu asomfoɔ nyɛ ɛyerenom mmaako mmaako kununom, nni wɔn mma ne wɔn ara fie so yie. 13Na wɔn a wɔsom yie no, nya nnyinasoɔ pa ne nnam bebree, gyidie a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu mu.
Nyankopɔn asafo
14M’ani da so sɛ mɛba wo nkyɛn ntɛm pa deɛ, nanso meretwerɛ yeinom mabrɛ wo ansa, 15#2 Ti 2.20; Efe 2.19-22 na sɛ ebia mekyɛre a, woahunu sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wobu wo bra Nyankopɔn fie a ɛyɛ Nyankopɔn teasefoɔ no asafo, nokorɛ dum ne nnyinasoɔ no mu. 16#Yoh 1.14; Yoh 16.10; Rom 1.4; Mar 16.19 Na adeɛ a wɔpae mu ka sɛ ɛso ne onyamesom pa ahuntasɛm no:
Onyankopɔn yii ne ho adi honam mu,
wɔbuu no bem honhom mu,
ɔyii ne ho kyerɛɛ abɔfoɔ,
wɔkaa ne ho asɛm amanaman mu,
wɔgyee no dii wiase,
wɔfaa no kɔɔ soro, animuonyam mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Ɛyɛ nokwasɛm sɛ, sɛ obi pɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ adwuma a, na wapɛ adwuma pa. Nso deɛ ɛsɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ ne sɛ wɔnnya ne ho asɛm bi nka, ɔyɛ ɔyerɛ baako kunu, n’ani so da hɔ, n’adwene mu te, ɔyɛ ne ho wesee, ɔpɛ ahɔhoyɛ, ɔnim nkyerɛkyerɛ, ɔnyɛ ɔsadweam, ɔnyɛ pupopupo, na mmom ɔdwo, ɔnyɛ ntɔkwapɛ, ɔnyɛ sikanibereɛ; ɔdi ɔno ara ne fie so yie ma ne mma hyɛ n’ase animuduro nyinaa mu. Na sɛ obi nhunu ne fie so hwɛ a, ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na ɔbɛhwɛ Nyankopɔn asafo soɔ? Ɔnyɛ abɛɛfo, na wanhoran anhwe ɔbonsam atemmuo mu. Nanso ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔtete ho no bɔ no din pa, na wanhwe ahohora ne ɔbonsam afidie mu.

Asafo mu asomfoɔ nso, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn anim yɛ duro, wɔnyɛ ano nta, wɔnyɛ asadweam, wɔnyɛ adufudepɛfoɔ; wɔde gyidie ahuntasɛm no sie ahonim a emu teɛ mu. Ma wɔnsɔ yeinom nhwɛ kane, na sɛ asɛm bi nni wɔn ho ansa a, wɔama wɔasom. Mmaa no nso anim nyɛ duru saa ara, wɔnnyɛ nsekubɔfoɔ, wɔn ani so nna hɔ, wɔnni ade nyinaa mu nokorɛ. Asafo mu asomfoɔ nyɛ ɛyerenom mmaako mmaako kununom, nni wɔn mma ne wɔn ara fie so yie. Na wɔn a wɔsom yie no, nya nnyinasoɔ pa ne nnam bebree, gyidie a ɛwɔ Kristo Yesu mu mu.

M’ani da so sɛ mɛba wo nkyɛn ntɛm pa deɛ, nanso meretwerɛ yeinom mabrɛ wo ansa, na sɛ ebia mekyɛre a, woahunu sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wobu wo bra Nyankopɔn fie a ɛyɛ Nyankopɔn teasefoɔ no asafo, nokorɛ dum ne nnyinasoɔ no mu. Na adeɛ a wɔpae mu ka sɛ ɛso ne onyamesom pa ahuntasɛm no:
Onyankopɔn yii ne ho adi honam mu,
wɔbuu no bem honhom mu,
ɔyii ne ho kyerɛɛ abɔfoɔ,
wɔkaa ne ho asɛm amanaman mu,
wɔgyee no dii wiase,
wɔfaa no kɔɔ soro, animuonyam mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
